title: Portfolio Projects for Aspiring Cybersecurity Analysts

projects.title: Home Virtual SOC Lab with Splunk & Sysmon
projects.summary: Build a multi-machine virtual lab using VirtualBox or VMware containing an Ubuntu Linux attack box, a Windows 10 target machine instrumented with Microsoft Sysmon, and an Ubuntu Splunk server.
step_by_step: 1. Install VirtualBox and spin up an Ubuntu Server VM running Splunk Free.
2. Configure a Windows VM with SwiftOnSecurity Sysmon config and install the Splunk Universal Forwarder.
3. Emulate benign user traffic and malicious PowerShell attacks.
4. Write Splunk SPL queries to detect encoded PowerShell commands, process injection, and brute force login attempts.
5. Build a custom SOC dashboard tracking MITRE ATT&CK techniques observed.
portfolio_deliverables: GitHub repository with lab topology diagram, Splunk queries, detection rules, and incident write-up report.

projects.title: Automated Python Network Sniffer & Packet Parser
projects.summary: Write a Python tool using Scapy or raw sockets that captures network traffic on a network interface, extracts packet headers (IP, TCP, UDP, DNS), flags abnormal flags (e.g. SYN flood patterns), and logs suspicious activity to CSV/JSON.
step_by_step: 1. Use Python's scapy library to sniff incoming packets on a local network adapter.
2. Parse IP source/destination addresses and identify active protocols.
3. Implement rate-limiting detection to catch rapid SYN packets directed at closed ports.
4. Export captured anomalies into a structured JSON log format with timestamps.
portfolio_deliverables: Clean Python script with modular functions, unit tests with synthetic PCAP files, and README with usage screenshots.

projects.title: Vulnerability Assessment & Remediation Report
projects.summary: Conduct a vulnerability assessment on intentionally vulnerable lab targets (e.g., Metasploitable 2 or OWASP Juice Shop) using Nmap and OpenVAS/Nessus Essentials. Author a professional remediation report with CVSS scoring.
step_by_step: 1. Deploy vulnerable VM in an isolated host-only virtual network.
2. Run comprehensive Nmap service discovery and vulnerability scripts (NSE).
3. Launch an OpenVAS/Nessus vulnerability scan and categorize critical, high, and medium CVEs.
4. Formulate executive summary and technical patching steps.
portfolio_deliverables: Professional PDF vulnerability assessment report modeled after commercial pentest deliverable standards.
